reflux_tier_why: Middling (x1.0). Dark's swing comes from where the fight is (Lit, Dim or Dark), not from heat, so its reflux stays neutral like water's, the reference affinity. A per-affinity shed rule could come later (sheds faster while you stand in Dark: resting in the shadows), but it is not needed for the rule to read.
rule: Dark is strongest where the light is weakest: every spot is Lit, Dim or Dark; dark hits do +25% to a target standing in Dark and -20% in Lit, you are Unseen while you stand in Dark, and dark skills make their own Dark.
rule_refined_from: design/14 first pass: 'strongest where the light is weakest; shadows are places it can use: it hides in them, moves through them and feeds on light'.
rule_why: Kept, and turned into something the game can count, in the shape of water's wetness: three light levels instead of a sliding scale. 'Strongest' is +25% on targets in Dark; 'hides in them' is Unseen; 'moves through them' is Shadow Slip, which can only land in a shadow; 'feeds on light' is Hungry Dark. The missing piece in the first pass was where darkness comes from in a lit room: dark skills leave Dark ground, and every body throws a shadow behind it. This keeps dark apart from light (dark never travels as a beam and never lights anything: Silhouette outlines a target against the dark, Daybreak gives up your own dark to do it) and from wind and water's area control (dark zones change who can see, not where bodies are).
_note: DRAFT 2026-10-22 [MODEL]. Dark is not in the game. One skill per base rune (runes.json DRK-1a..5b), three starters, an effect for each rune. Field names follow abilities.json; new keys are named in new_mechanics. 'blinded' is defined here once and is also used by ice (Whiteout, the Snow effect). The light level is the biggest new system any of these drafts needs.

skills.name: Blot
skills.summary: A blot of darkness, thrown: 60 damage, and where it lands the ground goes Dark in a circle 2.5 m across for 6 s. Hit them again while they stand in it.
skills.verb_fit: Darken is 'make it darker'. The bolt is the delivery; what it does is put a patch of Dark exactly where the fight is, so the second blot, and everything else dark does there, hits harder.

new_mechanics.name: light level
new_mechanics.definition: Every spot is Lit, Dim or Dark. A level has a base (open day Lit; dungeons, swamps and night Dim); fires, Alight bodies, torches and light skills make Lit circles; dark ground makes Dark; the 1.5 m behind every enemy and stone, away from the main light, is Dark (its shadow). Dark hits do +25% to a target in Dark, -20% in Lit.

new_mechanics.name: dark ground
new_mechanics.definition: A zone with 'dark': true counts as Dark whatever the light, for its life; a Lit source inside it (fire, a light skill) wins where they overlap.

new_mechanics.name: unseen
new_mechanics.definition: On the player while standing in Dark: enemies more than 4 m away lose sight of you (ranged ones cannot start an aim; melee ones without a slot go to where they last saw you). Striking or casting reveals you for 1 s.

good_modifiers.word: A wider blot: the dark patch and the flight both grow, a little less damage.
The patch stays Dark 9 s.
A blot in the eyes: what it hits is Blinded, and the patch lasts longer.

bad_modifiers.why: Lighten is Darken's opposite: a blot that lets the light in. Darken keeps the pull, so the daze it would add sits at the edge of taking hold, and there is no wind-up for its other half.
No wind-up to shorten; it leaves the hand at once. Falls back.

skills.name: Daybreak
skills.summary: Every pool of your darkness within 12 m lifts at once. Each enemy standing in one is caught in the sudden light: Dazed for 1.5 s and Exposed for 4 s. You lose the dark you made.
skills.verb_fit: Lighten is 'let the light back in'. Dark's only skill that ends darkness, and the reason to: what was hidden in your shadows is suddenly lit and outlined.

new_mechanics.name: lift dark
new_mechanics.definition: detonate with 'consume_zone': every zone of that kind the caster owns within range ends at once, and on_hit is applied to every enemy standing in one.

good_modifiers.word: Lifts pools farther away.
Light floods in sooner: recovery a quarter shorter.
Cheaper to throw away your own dark: 15% less essence.

bad_modifiers.why: Darken is Lighten's opposite and pulls harder: lifting the dark and deepening it at once. Daybreak has no damage or duration for its ops; falls back.
Daybreak already Exposes everything it catches; the status op does not stack. Falls back.
Not a shot. Falls back.

skills.name: Pall
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: a pall of darkness 3.5 m across for 7 s. Nothing sees into it or through it: an aim from outside cannot pick out anything inside, and enemies inside are Blinded. It counts as Dark.
skills.verb_fit: Obscure is 'hide a thing in darkness'. The pall hides whatever is in it, you included, from everything outside; it is cover you carry to the fight.

new_mechanics.name: blinded
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 3 s (refreshed while in the zone that gives it): cannot see past 2 m. A ranged enemy cannot aim; a melee enemy swings at where it last saw you and gives up its slot.

new_mechanics.name: blocks sight
new_mechanics.definition: A zone with 'blocks_sight': enemy aims and lines of sight that start outside it cannot pass into or through it.

good_modifiers.word: The pall hangs 10.5 s.
Drop it farther off, and wider.
15% cheaper.

bad_modifiers.why: Expose is Obscure's opposite: outlining what you are hiding. Obscure keeps the pull, but the Expose status would still land on every tick, undoing the cover.
Not a shot. Falls back.
The pall stays where you put it; nothing travels. Falls back.

skills.name: Silhouette
skills.summary: One enemy within 12 m is outlined against the dark for 6 s: every hit on it counts as from behind (+30%, and a raised shield does not help). If it stands in Dark it is Blinded as well.
skills.verb_fit: Expose is 'make a hidden target stand out'. The outline is the exposure: it cannot hide behind its shield or its friends any more.

new_mechanics.name: exposed
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, the skill's duration (default 6 s): every hit on it counts as a rear hit (balance.combat rear_mult, frontal block ignored), and it cannot be hidden or Unseen.

good_modifiers.word: The outline holds 9 s.
Outline something 16.8 m away.
A darker outline: lasts longer, and the touch bites harder.

bad_modifiers.why: Obscure is Expose's opposite and pulls harder (2.62 vs 1.9): hiding the thing you are outlining. The maths would Blind it and leave Expose's own status only just taking hold.
Not a shot. Falls back.
Nothing to quicken; it is instant. Falls back.

skills.name: Shadow Slip
skills.summary: Sink into the dark and rise from another shadow up to 10 m away: a Dark spot, or the shadow behind an enemy, which puts you at its back. Your first hit within 1 s counts as from behind. It cannot take you into the light.
skills.verb_fit: Shadowstep is 'move through shadows'. You can only arrive in one, and every enemy carries one behind it.

new_mechanics.name: shadow landing
new_mechanics.definition: blink with 'needs_shadow': the point must be Dark (light level), or an enemy, in which case you arrive in its shadow, 1 m behind it and facing its back; a Lit point is refused before essence is spent. 'rear_window': your hits in that time count as rear hits.

good_modifiers.word: Out of the shadow sooner: recovery a quarter shorter.
A longer step through the dark: 13 m.
15% cheaper.

bad_modifiers.why: Pin is Shadowstep's opposite and pulls far harder (3.85 vs 2.2): nailing your own shadow as you step. The step's reach is halved, and the status has no hit to ride on.
Nothing to pierce. Falls back.
A step held still is not a step. No duration, no speed field; falls back.

skills.name: Shadownail
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a black nail is driven into the shadows in a circle 1.5 m across. Whatever stands there after a quarter second takes 50 and is Shadowbound for 2.5 s (4 s in Dark): rooted where it stands, though it can still turn and swing.
skills.verb_fit: Pin is 'nail a target's shadow, and the target with it'. You aim at the ground, because it is the shadow you nail.

new_mechanics.name: shadowbound
new_mechanics.definition: 1 stack, 2.5 s: cannot move from the spot (can turn and attack); shoves and pulls do not move it. Standing in Lit halves what is left.

good_modifiers.word: A wider nail: the circle and the throw grow 30%, a little less damage.
Driven in at once: the quarter-second mark shortens.
Nailed and knocked down a peg: 30% more poise damage.

bad_modifiers.why: Shadowstep is Pin's opposite: moving the thing you nail down. The maths would lengthen its reach; the sense is gone.
A nail does not travel. No speed field; falls back.
Not a shot. Falls back.

skills.name: Muffle
skills.summary: For 6 s you make no sound. Striking no longer reveals you while you are Unseen, an enemy you hit that was not facing you takes +50%, and anything you kill raises no alarm.
skills.verb_fit: Hush is 'smother sound'. Your own: the dark already hides you from sight, and Muffle takes away the noise that gives you away.

new_mechanics.name: muffled
new_mechanics.definition: self_buff: hits do not break Unseen; a hit on an enemy whose front arc you are outside does unaware_mult; a kill sends no reinforcements signal and wakes no one nearby.

good_modifiers.word: Silent for 9 s.
Worn closer, lasts 30% longer.
Hushed at once: recovery a quarter shorter.

bad_modifiers.why: Resound is Hush's opposite: an echo in a hush. Hush keeps the pull, and the buff has no area or poise for Resound's ops; falls back.
Silence worn on you has no range. Falls back.
Nothing it shoots. Falls back.

skills.name: Knell
skills.summary: Point, 10 m: a tolling note rings over a circle 3 m across, three tolls 0.6 s apart, each 35 damage and 20 poise. In Dark the echo answers: two more tolls.
skills.verb_fit: Resound is 'sound carries and echoes in the dark'. The note carries (it rings over an area) and echoes (it repeats), and it echoes longer in the dark.

new_mechanics.name: dark echo
new_mechanics.definition: A zone with 'dark_extra_ticks' runs that many more ticks if its centre is Dark when it would end.

good_modifiers.word: The note rings longer: more tolls.
Carries farther: a wider circle, each toll a little softer.
Each toll heavier, for more essence.

bad_modifiers.why: Hush is Resound's opposite and pulls harder (3.1 vs 2.15): a hushed bell. Its echo shrinks, and Hush only buys a few more tolls of a quieter note.
Not a shot. Falls back.
The zone has no wind-up; Haste cannot speed the tolls. Falls back.

skills.name: Hungry Dark
skills.summary: The dark around you feeds. Everything within 3 m takes 1.6x strike damage; for each one hit you take back 2 essence (up to 4 hits) and swallow 1 light (up to 5). The ground under you goes Dark for 5 s, and any fire it touches goes out.
skills.verb_fit: Devour is 'swallow light and energy'. It swallows both: essence back for every body, the light around you (fire put out, the ground gone Dark), and a store of swallowed light for Night Spill to let out.

new_mechanics.name: swallowed
new_mechanics.definition: On the player: a store of up to 5 swallowed light, 12 s from the last gain. Hungry Dark adds swallow_per_hit per enemy hit, +1 for each fire it puts out; Night Spill spends all of it.

new_mechanics.name: douse
new_mechanics.definition: 'douses': fire zones in the area end, and Alight is removed from every enemy hit.

good_modifiers.word: A wider hunger: 30% more reach and dark ground, a little less damage.
A closer, harder bite.
The dark it leaves lasts 7.5 s.

bad_modifiers.why: Disgorge is Devour's opposite and the bond is ionic (4.0 vs 1.8): Devour takes the whole pull and Disgorge does nothing at all. Swallowing and spitting at once.
Not a shot. Falls back.
The burst is around you; nothing travels. Falls back.

skills.name: Night Spill
skills.summary: Let out what the dark swallowed: a cone 6 m long. 30 damage, plus 30 for every light swallowed, to everything in it, and the ground it covers goes Dark for 5 s. At 3 or more they are Dazed.
skills.verb_fit: Disgorge is 'release what was swallowed'. It is Hungry Dark's other half: worth little on its own, everything after a feed.

new_mechanics.name: spend store
new_mechanics.definition: A skill with 'consume' spends all of that player store: per_stack_damage for each, and 'daze_at' or more also Dazes.

good_modifiers.word: A narrow gout: 30% harder, a shorter cone.
A wide spill: more ground made Dark, each a little less.
Spill it darker: harder, and the Dark it leaves lasts longer.

bad_modifiers.why: Devour is Disgorge's opposite and the bond is ionic (4.0 vs 1.8): it eats the spill. Disgorge's own hold on the skill drops to nothing; what is left is a cheaper, cooler cast.
Not a shot. Falls back.
No wind-up to shorten. Falls back.
